title: A job after the uniform
notes: Storyboard and plan agree. The White Paper is shown twice: its title page then the typeset quotation card on P4.12, and on P4.17 ('a promise on paper') the real printed foreword paragraph, then a pull back to the whole page, so the promise ends as one paragraph on a sheet of paper.

The plan's 'Diary for Timothy ≈17:00, a man laying bricks' is not at 17:00 in the picture-only file (that is the mine clearance, #109-110). Used instead: #109, a soldier in beret clearing a beach mine (16:45) for 'in uniform', and #76, a roofer re-slating a bomb-damaged roof (11:45) for 'civilian work'. No bricklaying shot was found in Diary for Timothy on the sheets viewed.

Beveridge poster (LSE, 1498×2396, portrait): the push runs down the poster from the headline DEMAND THE 'BEVERIDGE' PLAN to the benefit rows (Comprehensive Medical Service… FOR EVERYONE). Zoom stays at or under 2.0× fit, which is still under the file's native size, so the validator's under-1920 PUSH warning is intended.

Charley's March of Time: the castle rising on the hill and the swarm of little builders on its ladders (shot 18, ≈3:53-3:59) for 'Keynes wasn't building this future alone', rather than the road itself.
Diary for Timothy has no credit string in footage.md (as scene 11 notes); left null.
